sentences.en: We had to drive on narrow roads through hilly terrain.
sentences.zh: 我们只能在狭窄的山路上开车。

sentences.en: Most of northern Algeria is made up of mountainous terrain.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚北部主要是山区。

sentences.en: The rough terrain checked the progress of the hikers.
sentences.zh: 崎岖的地势阻碍了徒步者的前进。

senses.zh: 地形，地势,地面，地带,地理岩层,（知识的）领域范围
